new_results.statement: For two original cap-one hubs H and an independent joint slope/residual pair (S,Z) with joint density rho satisfying M_r=||rho||_{L_z^r L_s^2}<infinity for 1<r<=2, Q=H^TCH+2H^TS+Z has a continuous C0 density with ||p_Q||inf <= C_joint(r) M_r^{r/(2r-1)}.

If S=S0+T with S0 independent of (T,Z'), density cap K for S0, and marginal density q of Z' in L^r, then the joint density rho_(S,Z') satisfies ||rho||_{L_z^r L_s^2} <= K^{1/2}||q||_r, even when T is arbitrarily correlated with Z'.

With source split H|Y|U|V, S0=BY+d, affine base phase ell.S0+r0, direct hub shift T=aU+bV, and hyperbolic edge 2cUV+beta U+gamma V+delta, the density is continuous and ||p_Q||inf <= C_r det(BB^T)^(-r/[4(2r-1)]) |c|^(-(r-1)/(2r-1)); at r=2 the exact constant is 3.

partner_result_applied.actual_inequality: After the shear Z'=Z-ell.T, the partner estimate ||p_Z'||_r <= 2^((r-1)/r)|c|^(-(r-1)/r) feeds the new slope-shift mixed-norm compiler despite direct T=aU+bV coupling into both hub slopes.

next_step: Handle simultaneous nonlinear/quadratic same-bank curvature R(Y) not affine in S0=BY+d and a direct random hub-slope shift T(W) correlated with its smoothing residual, via a dimension-free convolution/mixed-norm transversality estimate or an existing rank-three cross-volume exit.
